#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Error handler
error_exit() {
    local line=$1
    local msg="${2:-Unknown error}"
    echo "Error at line $line: $msg" >&2
    cleanup
    exit 1
}

trap 'error_exit ${LINENO}' ERR

# Cleanup function
cleanup() {
    echo "Cleaning up..."
    # Cleanup code here
}

# Register cleanup on exit
trap cleanup EXIT

# Main script logic
main() {
    echo "Starting process..."
    # Your code here
}

main "$@"
